limitations: Company and agency results are attributed; this verification is not independent replication.
AMIE setting and preparation-survey denominator were checked in the March manuscript. October journal full text was not independently retrieved. No clinical recommendation is made.
The MBA trial randomized 86 students; 46 remained in its screened main assessment analysis. The undergraduate trial had approximately 15% tutor take-up. Different designs do not rank all AI tutors.
Anthropic January 2026 deskilling is modeled removal of tasks using November 2025 usage and an imperfect education proxy; it is not observed worker skill loss or a causal wage estimate.
Anthropic October evidence concerns its own workforce. OpenAI September evidence concerns recurring cross-occupation usage, not independent mastery or higher pay.
The Digitalist Papers contains individual authors’ arguments, not a consensus forecast.
Grid Protectors concerns commitments for planned infrastructure, not realized bill reductions. Robotics examples do not establish general autonomy.
The household calculations are hypothetical, before tax, with specified hours and costs.
Earlier evidence is explicitly dated; this is a selective monthly edition, not an exhaustive news roundup.
